notes.title: Finally, an online game shutting down the right way: Islands of Insight will close servers next month and 'permanently modify the game to be offline-only' so the promising puzzler can live on
notes.notes: I liked the shared-world puzzle game Islands of Insight quite a bit when it came out in 2023, and so did some of my PC Gamer compatriots. Alas, it wasn't able to find an audience, and today the Islands of Insight community team announced that, like so many other online games, the servers will be shut down at the end of August. But the good news is that even without remote servers, you'll be able to keep on playing... Read more.

notes.title: Islands of Insight | What's Next
notes.notes:
[i]Update Oct. 30: Islands of Insight is now offline-only.[/i]

Seekers, our final Islands of Insight update will arrive [b]on October 30, 2024[/b], which will permanently modify the game to be offline-only. This will allow Islands of Insight to live on for all Seekers to find and enjoy, while we focus our efforts onto our next projects.

[u]For what to expect, here is what you need to know:  [/u]   
[list]
[*] The online servers will officially shutdown [b]on October 30, 2024[/b]
[*] Any online progression that is not transferred [b]before October 30[/b] will be lost
[*] There are no plans for more content to support the offline version
[*] All the online features will no longer be available
[*] Puzzles will continue to respawn throughout all zones
[*] There will be no bug fixes/balance changes with the final update, however we are reducing the frequency of player position saving in response to community feedback about SSD wear and potential file corruption.  
[/list] 

[u]How to transfer your progression:  [/u]
[list]
[*] Launch the game, and choose Play Online
[*] In the main menu, select Account and Click on Download Gameplay Progress
[*] A confirmation popup will appear: Click on Download Progress to start the download 
[*] After a few seconds, confirmation that the download was successful will appear and you are all done
[*] Exit the game, and start it again, but this time select Play Offline to continue playing your own progression. 
[/list]

[b]**Additional note:[/b] if you had already previously downloaded progression, the button will display “Override Progress” instead. You can decide if you want to replace it with your current online progression or not.

If you have any issue, please reach out to our customer service here https://islands-of-insight.zendesk.com/hc/en-us


We remain extremely proud of the many puzzles we’ve solved together in our shared-world. We sincerely thank you for all your support throughout this journey!

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Offline Mode Available Now!
notes.notes:
Seekers, it is here. Our Offline Mode is live now!

We are happy to expand our play experience and provide more players with the opportunity to join us in the islands and solve beautiful puzzles. 

For what to expect, we covered the details in our previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2071500/view/4201376568911888304?l=english]post[/url], but in case you missed it, here are the highlights:
[list]
[*] You no longer need to be tethered to an internet connection to play the game
[*] The world is still brimming with puzzles and has the same biomes. Puzzles will also respawn, and you will be able to do daily quests
[*] Any social / online functionality, like emoting or pinging other players will not be available in this mode
[*] Content has been balanced, modified or removed to fit with the single player experience
[/list]

A world brimming with puzzles await for you. See you on the islands!

[h2]Update 1.2.6 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Party invite button, which can currently be found in your Friend menu while playing, is fixed. 
[*] Hidden Pentad shrinking bubble upgrade now works as intended. 
[*] Players will no longer experience any soft locks when using Fast Travel. 
[*] Issue with Enclaves losing progression is fixed. 
[*] Archipelago of Curiosity objectives will now all appear in the Quest Log as intended. 
[*] Quest log will now reflect remaining amount of puzzles to solve for multiple Enclaves that had been missing 
[*] Additional graphical and performance improvements. 
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Eye of the Needle enclave primary goal grants two Mirabilis’ at once. 
[*] Map markers may cause solid collisions on some puzzles 
[*] Gather No Moss – Multiple Rolling Block puzzles in the location do not zoom in correctly when using ultrawide screen. 
[*] A Party leader is unable to disband the party by leaving it from the Pause Menu. 

[b]The following bugs only impact the Demo version of IOI: [/b]
[*] After downloading save file and switching from Online to Offline on the Demo, Question For Perfection challenge is not marked as complete 
[*] Two for One - Challenge cannot be completed due to lack of puzzles 
[/list]

notes.title: Gorgeous puzzle game Islands of Insight soars amid free Steam giveaway
notes.notes:
It's tough to beat the joy of claiming a good free Steam game, and if you're quick you might be able to do just that, as beautiful puzzle game Islands of Insight celebrates the news of its much-requested offline mode with a free game giveaway. Reminiscent of The Witness, this multiplayer open-world game is available to claim free on Steam for just 24 hours, and it's already seen the game's player count rise dramatically on the Valve platform.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Offline Mode Release Date
notes.notes:
Seekers, we are so happy to announce that our Offline Mode will be released on July 9! 

This addition provides you, our dedicated players, and new players with more flexibility in how you enjoy the islands and our beautiful puzzles. 

[b]Play Anywhere‍ [/b]

With our Offline Mode, you no longer need to be tethered to an internet connection. You can experience Islands of Insight without worrying about unreliable connection and delays. 
 
[b]A Mode Brimming With Puzzles[/b] 

Our offline mode is brimming with puzzles. The mode has the same biomes and puzzles quantity and diversity as the online version. Puzzles will also respawn, and you will be able to do daily quests. 

[b]What to Expect‍ [/b]

Our goal is to have a similar experience between the online mode and the offline version. It's important to understand that any social / online functionality, like emoting or pinging other players will not be available in this mode. With this mode being exclusively available in single player, some content has been balanced, modified or removed. 

If you have been playing the game online, and want to switch to offline, don’t worry, you will be able to save your progression and transfer it over to Offline Mode.  

 

One last thing. The base game is available for FREE (to keep forever!) for 24 hours – so until tomorrow, June 27 at 1pm ET. This is your sign to join other Seekers and get your puzzle-solving on.  

See you on the islands!

notes.title: A Message on Offline Mode
notes.notes:
Seekers,  

We’ve got some exciting news to share with you! We’re aware that some of you have asked for an offline experience to help you enjoy Islands of Insight in your own way. We hear you and understand that playing online can come with a variety of frustrations.  

When creating this shared world, our vision was always to bring a fresh experience to the puzzle genre. We set out to create a game that could be played by many in an environment that promoted social interactions, community, and streaming – all without disrupting the experience of those who preferred to journey on their own.  

We’re happy to announce that Lunarch is currently developing an offline mode that will be released in the coming months. While this isn’t the easiest task, we’re excited to see where the journey will take us. In the meantime, follow our Steam blog posts and social channels for further updates.  

Thank you to everyone who has joined us on the Islands and shared their feedback. If you’re still waiting to take your first steps into this sublime world of puzzles, we’ve brought the demo back just for you. Get a taste of the incredible eureka moments that await you in Islands of Insight. 

See you on the Islands! 

The IOI team

Today we released an update with new content and technical improvements! Read below for details: 

[h2]New Content [/h2]

Added [b]The Archipelago of Curiosities[/b]—a large bonus endgame Enclave featuring some unusual and creative twists on your favourite puzzles. The entrance is off to the side of the Haven of Insight along the path toward Serene Deluge. 

Added [b]new grid rules and a new grid symbol[/b]. Awaken them by completing Bent Into Shape and Nearsighted—two new challenges in Autumn Falls and Serene Deluge respectively. New puzzles using each rule will spawn daily in the areas surrounding those challenges. 

Added [b]Two for One, Cross the Streams, Found the Difference, The Puzzle Cube, and See Serpents[/b]—five new themed logic grid challenges spread across the map. 

Added [b]Ground Away[/b]—a tricky group of Pillars of Insight in Serene Deluge. 

Added a fresh pack of [b]high-difficulty logic grids[/b] along the path between the Haven of Insight and the entrance to Shattered Library. There are now 5 spawn locations for these difficult puzzles instead of 3.

notes.title: Explore Islands of Insight | Part V: Serene Deluge
notes.notes:
Seekers, welcome to Part V of [i]Explore Islands of Insight[/i] – the last of a 5-part series where we have explored each biome of the game. 

The story of the land is that it was created by the Auroral from the memories of another world – our world, planet Earth. It allowed us to take inspiration from lots of different areas on the planet to create new and unique zones that do not normally exist. 

Today, we’ll be wrapping up this series by talking about Serene Deluge – let’s dive in! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/33927cfdf05483d7ea0e463e7e42290fc8b8d891.jpg[/img]

The first thing you’ll notice about this truly unique biome is its distinct shapes. The pillar-like cliffs of Serene Deluge were based on the very-real Zhangjiajie Mountains in China. We’ve scattered rifts throughout the terrain to give you every opportunity to soar and explore every inch of this vertical landscape. 

Like every other biome, we’ve fused a different timeless building style into the world. In Serene Deluge, the inspiration comes from the Khmer architecture of Cambodia, giving you a variety of rock-cut temples to explore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/43f77af906e12242bc666a0159309c7ff3cb6e54.jpg[/img]

This biome boasts three main Enclaves. Vaulted Heights introduced a new logic grid rule – Viewpoint Arrows*. The whole Enclave is based on the theme of seeing things from all angles, and includes Hidden Rings, Skydrops, and Hidden Relics.  

*unless you already found them in the bonus Enclave in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2071500/announcements/detail/4183351393018916728?snr=2___]Autumn Falls[/url] 😉) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/aba4654e7bd9922275b43762b384cc31781d19e0.jpg[/img]

Limber Cascades introduces a whole new puzzle type – Shifting Mosaics. With this sliding tile puzzle, getting from Point A to Point B may not be as easy as it first appears. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/e363cb655f8e09b72c516178dfdb363b02a3fcec.jpg[/img]

And Leaves in the Wind, will give you the chance to really test your wings with Glide Ring challenges, as well as some of the most clever Pattern Match puzzles the game has to offer. 

Explore even further to find more challenging Enclaves, testing what you’ve learned about Viewpoint Arrows and Shifting Mosaics.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/f76f1cda02b6d0781328627d16f1b67906d0f551.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much for reading along and learning about the various biomes in Islands of Insight. If you’ve missed previous editions, go back and learn about [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2071500/announcements/detail/4031353638208295151?snr=2___]Verdant Glen[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2071500/announcements/detail/4031353638212908824?snr=2___]Lucent Waters[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2071500/announcements/detail/4183351393018916728?snr=2___]Autumn Falls[/url], and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2071500/announcements/detail/4127057033595930743?snr=2___]Shady Wildwood[/url]. 

Which biome is your favorite? Let us know in the comments. 

Until next time, 

See you on the Islands!

notes.title: Explore Islands of Insight | Part IV: Shady Wildwood
notes.notes:
Seekers, welcome to Part IV of [i]Explore Islands of Insight[/i] – a 5-part series where we will explore each biome of the game. 

The story of the land is that it was created by the Auroral from the memories of another world – our world, planet Earth. It allowed us to take inspiration from lots of different areas on the planet to create new and unique zones that do not normally exist. 

Today we will talk about Shady Wildwood – let’s dive in! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/90fcc7175abf98e121f4a58f3dd3d023f4cf2811.png[/img]

Like every other biome, Shady Wildwood pulls ancient architecture – in this case Dravidian temples from India - into an unexpected landscape – the redwood forests of California. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/4a27b8eae0f5ef3732e91f5fd23895b72091d1af.png[/img]

Shady Wildwood, like the rest of Islands of Insight, offers plenty of sublime locations and experiences to breathe in and discover. Explore the expansive open world and climb to some of the highest points in the game on the tops of Dravidian Temples, overlooking the rest of whole of this beautiful world. Try to wrap your brain around Reflections in the Sky – a mind-bending inverted island filled with themed puzzles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/aaaf6092ff5f0a72b1da9be8de21eebe343ae5ac.png[/img]

One aspect that makes this biome unique is that it contains a handful of objectives focused on timing. The Cloud of Pearls Enclave will invite you into a temple filled with Skydrops, challenging you to solve them all within a time limit. Scurry Hurry is a testament to Movement puzzles, hiding a series of Flow Orbs inside the confines of a multi-story Crystal Labyrinth. Shady Wildwood also sees the return of the Match 3 Speed Challenge, which will test your Match 3 skills and your memory at the same time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/d1e9a7e082d44d29e31acd9d819f59bd702aac92.jpg[/img]

Discover a new logic grid rule in A Solitary Island. And make friends with the truly mysterious Shy Auras – a new puzzle type that is unlike anything in the game so far. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/aa5d6da055fe52879e498d819c64a83c3f1c5066.jpg[/img]

Play Islands of Insight now to solve and discover everything that Shady Wildwood has to offer. And stay tuned for Part 5, where we’ll wrap up our time Exploring Islands of Insight in the Serene Deluge.

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Frequently Asked Questions & Dev Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, Seekers! 
Here are some of the most frequently asked questions to help you know what to expect on [b]Islands of Insight[/b]!

[h2]Frequently Asked Questions [/h2]

[b]Requirements [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/8d41151413fcba848b4c9d4c14f3bacc1d6a3255.png[/img]

[b]How do I add friends?[/b] 
In order to play in the same party, both players must have launched Islands of Insight once. This will ensure you can appear on each other's in-game friend lists. 
[list]
[*] Once this has been done and you re-launch the game, press 'Tab' or click on the Tab icon at the top right to see your in-game friend list. Press the 'Join' button next to your friend's name. This will allow you to join the server your friend is in. 
[*] Now that you are on the map, simply press 'ESC' to view the menu, and press the 'Join' button here to invite your friend to your party. 
[*] Once they have accepted your invitation, you will be able to see them in your 'Party'. 
[*] You will be able to spot them easily when you meet them on the map, even if they go behind a wall. 
[/list]
[b]If I played the demo, will my progress carry over?[/b] 
Yes! Your progress from the February demo will carry over into the full version of the game. 

[b]Is there support for controllers?[/b] 
There is no support for the use of controllers for Islands of Insight at this time. 

[b]Is there Steam Deck support? [/b]
Islands of Insight is currently only supported and best played on Windows, you can view our minimum requirements here. Steam Deck, Mac, and Linux are currently not supported for Islands of Insight but we appreciate the feedback players have provided us so far. 

[b]How do I change my name?[/b] 
Your in-game name is taken from your Steam profile name. If you update your Steam name, it will update in-game the next time you boot Islands of Insight.

[b]Is there a cap to a puzzle's Mastery level? [/b]
Yes, the highest level that you can achieve for the Mastery of any puzzle is level 99. 
Note: The bar may appear to move after you have hit level 99 

[b]How do I find more info about a specific puzzle? [/b]
The Encyclopedia contains all the information regarding the puzzles you have discovered so far. Make sure to use it to your advantage! 

Want to see the full FAQ or experiencing an issue? Please contact us here: 
[url=https://islands-of-insight.zendesk.com/hc/en-us]https://islands-of-insight.zendesk.com/hc/en-us[/url]

[h2]Developer’s Notes[/h2] 

[b]I played the Early Playtest in September and/or the most recent demo during Steam Next Fest. What changes can I expect to find in the full game?[/b]  
[list]
[*] The complete experience: 4 new biomes filled with new puzzle types, Enclaves and challenges. 
[*] New daily quests - more quest types and the ability to cancel quests, giving the player greater agency.  
[*] Improved player progression: addition of puzzles awakening, which adds improved sense of progression in completing the campaign, and ensures players engage with tutorials at the right time. 
[*] Revisions on lore, map, costume art, user interface, puzzle collection, difficulty, and several Enclaves. 
[*] And we also did something special with the pyramid... 
[/list]

notes.title: Explore Islands of Insight | Part III: Autumn Falls
notes.notes:
Seekers, welcome to Part III of [i]Explore Islands of Insight[/i] - a 5-part series where we will explore each biome of the game.  

The story of the land is that it was created by the Auroral from the memories of another world - our world (planet Earth). It allowed us to take inspiration from lots of different areas on the planet to create new and unique zones that do not normally exist. 
 
Today we will talk about Autumn Falls – let's dive in! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/2a79d88d51152e4593c1a9543689374da021d0b2.png[/img]

This rustic, yet jaw-dropping environment finds balance in its contrasts, like its tiny island in the middle of a massive open-air crater. The idea for combining the rugged Canadian Niagara Escarpment and China’s stunning hanging temples came from wanting to celebrate some of our team members being from these parts of the world.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/53327772e355ec76f33219cc6267aeac7999ec6e.png[/img]

While exploring these magnificent riverlands, you can expect to encounter Phasic Dials for the first time. These new puzzles will challenge your observation and strategic thinking as you turn each dial to its satisfying final location. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/fd23ac284738de6fcf47d76093781f487dd06fcd.jpg[/img]

The Enclaves in Autumn Falls are among the most unique in the game. Dyads in the Mist is a test of perception that will force you to expand your horizons to find all the puzzles, let alone solve them. The Cliff and the Void was lovingly constructed as an homage ying-yang puzzles, beloved by the puzzle community. And The Phase and the Melody will not only introduce Phasic Dials, but also offer the game’s first deep dive into Music Grids. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/1d496eb55771534a64b0797fc7ea8c11a94ddf93.jpg[/img]

And for those paying close attention, there is even a bonus island, on which new symbols are introduced to Logic Grids!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/ee17857641c2493b8ff6304264b577fbf21e3b84.jpg[/img]

Beyond the Enclaves, there are quests to discover, like a sequence of Underclued Logic Grids, a Pillar of Insight, a Quest for Perfection, and the Riverland Bridge, which will test your eyes and ears as a dense but tricky search for Hidden Cubes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/93c8b48fcfab0cd72f8606111dcf3840e7b69f39.png[/img]

Play Islands of Insight now to solve and discover everything that Autumn Falls has to offer. And stay tuned for Part 4, where we’ll continue to Explore Islands of Insight in the Shady Wildwood.

notes.title: Explore Islands of Insight | Part II: Lucent Waters
notes.notes:
Seekers, welcome to Part II of [i]Explore Islands of Insight[/i] - a 5-part series where we will explore each biome of the game.  

The story of the land is that it was created by the Auroral from the memories of another world - our world (planet Earth). It allowed us to take inspiration from lots of different areas on the planet to create new and unique zones that do not normally exist. 
 
Today we will talk about Lucent Waters, so let's dive in! 

The theme of this serene biome is Greco-Roman architecture, combined with an awe-inspiring landscape whose beauty is natural, yet fantastical. Inspired by the Caño Cristales areas of Columbia in South America - with crystal-clear water and colorful seaweeds, it is hard not to stop and admire the beauty around you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/d586ea4cd54cd33f2e6309e71dede757a42664b8.png[/img]

Right behind the plaza, it is impossible not to notice the Haven of Insight, a sublime island with a familiar face on its rocks - a clue for one of the many secrets of the islands. The Haven of Insight can be considered as the lobby or hub area of the game. Right in its middle, you will find the Great Pearl and once you interact with it, this new zone will be awakened and added to your map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/f79db0df154e825856dea915ef41bc30b840030b.png[/img]

Next to the Great Pearl, you will find The Effigy of the Ancient One which holds Luminous Quests - additional bonus challenges that will award extra Sparks if you complete them.  

Speaking of challenges, as you wonder the unknown, besides the puzzles from Verdant Glen, you will encounter new types of puzzles such as Rolling Blocks, and other unawakened puzzles.  

You will also find areas in the open world with a specific type of challenge, for example [i]Dance of the Fireflies[/i] - a collection of Wandering Echoes - for those looking for delightful surprises. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/024476fce72a3f8ede68bbdd29df688c9ccefc4e.jpg[/img]

Lucent Waters features 5 Enclaves as part of the single player campaign - outside the open world: Shattered Oasis, The Trick of The Wanderer, Gather No Moss, Shattered Library, And Ancient Court – all with unique design, challenges, and insights. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/7357546dc55cf275d2553f0a6eb0df8abeda09da.png[/img]

Spread your wings and glide above this beautiful location as you embark on the Path of Discovery.  

Play a part of our world today in our demo. The full game releases on February 13. Wishlist today. And stay tuned for Part 3 where we will dive into the Autumn Falls biome.

notes.title: Explore Islands of Insight | Part I: Verdant Glen
notes.notes:
Seekers, today we begin to Explore [i]Islands of Insight[/i] - a 5-part series where we will discover each biome of the game.  

The story of the land is that it was created by the Auroral from the memories of another world - our world, planet Earth. This allowed us to take inspiration from lots of different areas on the planet to create new and unique zones that don’t normally exist. 
 
Let’s dive in with Part I by welcoming you to Verdant Glen. 

This is the first biome you’ll discover when you enter the main island of the game. It is impossible not to notice the epic, ancient architecture situated in an unusual setting, right in the middle of a beautiful and vibrant rainforest.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/3f7d969bdd32b485ebbdcff275387f27dea9bf1c.png[/img]
Early concept art 
 
One of our devs’ goals, in building the world, was to create an awe-inspiring, sublime feeling of a mysterious world brimming with puzzles - that kind of making your heart quake, catch-in-your-throat feeling of, “What is this?” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/587020f3a2072ff8956d6606d78bb8281a7c7313.jpg[/img]

And there is nothing like a floating double pyramid and ancient sublime architectures inspired by ancient Egypt to make you feel exactly that as you explore this zone and solve its puzzles.  

Speaking of puzzles, as you venture deeper into the zone, you will encounter Memory and Logic Grids, Crystal Labyrinths, and Match Three puzzles, and other unawakened puzzles.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/467697373cf2813710787ac7b60351a12c0da2c4.jpg[/img]

You will also find areas in the open world with a specific type of challenge, for example our first [i]Quest for Perfection[/i], where the game rewards logic over guesswork. Or Match 3 speed round for the most dedicated Match 3 players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/e1349fc71d0215df04e496448282b167b920caf3.jpg[/img]
Quest for Perfection 

If you are looking to solve objectives and learn more about a certain type of puzzle, Verdant Glen features 6 Enclaves as part of the single player campaign - outside the open world. Enclaves are specially curated sections of unique puzzles that will either teach a new puzzle type or mechanic or sometimes just show you something clever. You will need to complete quite a few to awaken all the different puzzle types in the game and unlock new playable areas. Enclaves aren’t unique to Verdant Glen – and we’ll highlight some others in future posts..  

The first Enclave of the biome (and the game itself), is The Empyrean Journey, where you will be able to unlock your wings and a world of beautiful vistas will open for you.  

Not only that, the expansive biome of Verdant Glen may or may not have secret Enclaves for you to discover.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/bb492cbd98bed393b0187ef038025fa79acdef03.jpg[/img]

Secrets and mysteries surround the story of how the lands came to be. As you embark on your journey, what secrets will you uncover? Have you ever wondered what could be inside the floating pyramid?  

Verdant Glen has so much to explore and discover. One thing is for sure, standing on the edge of a cliff, staring at an impossible double pyramid is a perfect example of the kinds of sublime experiences that await. 

Play a part of Verdant Glen today in our demo. The full game releases on February 13. Wishlist today. And stay tuned for Part II where we will dive into Lucent Waters.

notes.title: Shared world puzzle adventure Islands of Insight promises no frustrations, just a real chill time
notes.notes: Puzzle games usually aren't chillout games. They're challenges, brainteasers, mindbenders, and frustrations. Islands of Insight is not that kind of puzzle game. There's no linear path forcing you to tackle every puzzle in a set order, banging your head against whatever you're stuck on until you break through. Heck, there isn't even fall damage, so you can safely leap and parkour across its floating islands to your heart's content... Read more.

notes.title: Islands of Insight | What We’ve Been Up To
notes.notes:
Hello Seekers! It’s been just under three months since our reveal at the PC Gaming Show, so we want to fill you in on what we’ve been working on. 

First, in case you missed it, our free Open Steam Playtest is live NOW until September 21st (10am PDT / 1pm EDT). We couldn’t be more excited to be finally inviting you into our world and getting your feedback – letting us know which puzzles you love, and which parts of the world you’ve most enjoyed exploring. 

Since you last heard from us, we’ve been creating puzzles and making all sorts of improvements to the game. Gearing up for the Playtest, we really wanted to optimize the First Time User Experience, giving you a taste of both the expansive open world, and a variety and depth of puzzles. We’ve also been improving our UX and UI elements, progression and overall game flow to be as satisfying as possible. And, of course, we’re always optimizing to make the game run smoothly, so you can stay focused on your next eureka moment.  

But we’re far from finished. There is still a ton of work ahead of us, and your feedback from the playtest is going to make a huge difference in shaping what Islands of Insight will be going forward, so be sure to join our Playtest and let us know about your experience. 

See you on the Islands, 

The IOI Team

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Open Steam Playtest Build Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Content [/b]
[list]
[*] An early zone of the map is available for the open playtest. The flow for the Main Campaign and puzzle content have been modified to fit with the playable area available. 
[*] Some assets are placeholders and not reflective of the final game. 
[/list]

[b]Features[/b] 
[list]
[*] For this open playtest we are focusing on your solo journey so only a few social interactions are available at this time. 
[*] Our progression systems and their UI/UX are still being worked on and may not be indicative of their final implementation.

[list]
[*] The progression and difficulty scaling are not yet fully balanced. 
[*] Your experience points (XP) and Currencies (Coins) are not yet fully balanced, so your playstyle might influence your progression rate in unexpected ways. 
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3] 

The game is in pre-beta development therefore you may encounter bugs during your play experience. Currently known issues: 

[list]
[*] The only aspect ratio that is supported is 16:9, other aspect ratios (4:3, 21:9, etc.) are not currently supported. 
[*] There is no support for the use of controllers during the Open Steam Playtest. 
[*] If you believe you have encountered another issue, please head over to our [url=https://islands-of-insight.zendesk.com/hc/en-us ]support team’s portal[/url]. 
[/list]

[h3]System Requirements[/h3]

[list]

notes.title: I went hands-on with my most-anticipated upcoming open world game, and it didn't disappoint
notes.notes: Islands of Insight is like meditation. It's like a sauna followed by a steam room after a gym workout. It's like snuggling up by the fire on a cold and dark day, listening to ASMR while drinking hot chocolate and getting a foot massage. It's also infuriating. Pure brain-bursting, head-scratching, feet-stomping, temper-flaring, mood-shifting, controller-throwing exasperation. Until… hang on… I see! You stand here and look there and, et voila, you've solved a puzzle and all is right in the world again... Read more.

notes.title: This breathtaking puzzle game is The Witness with multiplayer
notes.notes:
Islands of Insight is so beautiful, it's made me a little emotional. Maybe the heat's getting to me, but watching the reveal trailer for this multiplayer puzzle game, formerly known as 'Project S,' from Behaviour Interactive has me desperate to dive into its grand, sweeping vistas. With its numerous sky islands covered in all manner of architecture ranging from ancient Greek and Egyptian designs to alien-like future tech, the mystery-strewn open world of Islands of Insight houses the most stunning puzzler since The Witness.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: If you'd rather explore a multiplayer open world where you solve puzzles than fight, here's the game for you
notes.notes: Exploring fantastical spaces with your friends like a pack of digital tourists is one of the true joys of videogames. All too often the pleasure of stopping to gaze in wonder at some impossible world is interrupted by having to murder a pack of wolves or deal with a trash mob of gribblies, however. Not so in Islands of Insight, Lunarch Studios' multiplayer game where the exploration is broken up by puzzles instead of battles... Read more.
